ambiguity: The text escalates first and only enters the extension if the manager is unreachable, so the decision is partly conditional. Responsibility is coded as owns because the fallback is the writer's own choice, described as 'ethically defensible' even though it breaches the rule. Law is coded because of the 'legal ... fallout' mention, which is weak. The text expresses no explicit regret or unease, only strong concern about irreversible harm, so discomfort is false. The escalation asks the manager to approve an exception before the deadline, which I coded as override_request. Asking for ratification at tomorrow's sitting is coded as flag_for_review.
